 V.Mohanraj .. Respondent  Criminal Original Petition has been filed under 482 of C  to call for the records culminating in S.T.C.No.141 of 2024 pending  the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate Court No.1 at Bhavani a  quash the same.
For Petitioners :Mr.B.Mohan  1/7 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  Crl.O.P.No.145

----
 ORDER
The petitioners herein are the accused in a private complaint initiated by the respondent alleging defamation.
2. The sum and substance of the private complaint is that the respondent under threat and compulsion married the first petitioner, who is the daughter of Chinnappan/2nd petitioner on 15.07.2022.

The respondent came to know that the first petitioner, the wife, has intimacy with one Praveen and to settle the claim of Praveen, he gave Rs.4 lakhs and even thereafter, they lived together hardly for 45 days and the first petitioner went back to her parents house.

However, on 08.09.2022, with an oblique motive to extract money, the first petitioner and her family members came to the house of the respondent and created scene, called local channel news men and made abusive comments about the respondent and the same was relied in the local news channel and print media.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3
. In the complaint, apart from the above said fact, the respondent had made certain other allegations regarding theft of data and electronic information by the first petitioner.

The complaint filed under Sections 120(b), 406, 420 and 500 of IPC, taken cognizance by the Judicial Magistrate and assigned S.T.C.No.141 of 2024.
4. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submitted that the respondent, after marrying the first petitioner deserted her and was not interested in resuming the matrimonial relationship.
To mend the relationship the first petitioner went to the house of the respondent.

However, the respondent was very arrogant and displayed his arrogance, which was noticed by the media men and the same was published in the print media as well as the local TV channels for which the first petitioner and other petitioners are not responsible.
After marrying the first petitioner, the respondent wants to deny the factum of marriage on the ground of threat and non consent for the marriage.

5. The learned Magistrate, who has recorded the statement of https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis the complainant had taken cognizance of the private complaint for offence under Section 500 of IPC as against A1 to A13, who are the petitioners herein which according to the petitioners' counsel is totally without any application of mind and without any material evidence to proceed against the petitioners for the offence under Section 500 of IPC and an act of the first petitioner in good faith to resume the matrimonial bond cannot be construed as an act of defamation, since such bonafide act done in good faith is exempted as per the exception under Sub Section 8 of Section 499 of IPC.
6.

The learned counsel appearing for the respondent submitted that the first petitioner, who belongs to the same village joined the office of the respondent as a Manager and thereafter, with the help of her relatives started threatening the respondent and he was forced to marry her.
Since she threatened him that she will commit suicide and accuse him for the cause of death, he married her.

sentences.text: 2 They both hardly lived for few days in Bengalore and got separated.
Necessary legal action been taken by the respondent to declare the said marriage as null and void.

Meanwhile, the first petitioner along with the other petitioners, who are https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis her relatives with pre-meditative design came to his house and created ruckus, abused the respondent in filthy language and got into all the activity picturized and the same was displayed as news in the local TV channels and newspapers.
Therefore, the intentional act to defame the respondent has to be prosecuted.

7. The facts narrated by the learned counsel appearing on either side and the documents including the complaint would clearly expose that the separation from the conjugal company of the first petitioner has forced the first petitioner and her relatives to go to the house of the respondent and seek for reunion.

Incidentally, the response of the respondent had created unwanted atmosphere,
which was attracted the public, who was media men leading to reports about the incident.
Neither the print media report nor the complaint disclose any expression by any of the petitioners, which would amount to defamation.

If at all there was abusive or filthy language used by the person, who assembled in front of the respondent house, the said filthy and abusive language should have been repeated in the complaint and there should have been an explanation, how such usage of the language had caused injury to the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis fame of the respondent.
8.
In the said circumstances, the cryptic order of the Judicial Magistrate taking cognizance of the offence without assigning reason suffers infirmity and liable to be quashed.
Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition is allowed and the case in S.T.C.No.141 of 2024 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate Court No.2, Bhavani, is hereby quashed.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
